label: Related list
description: A compact list of records that point at the current record through a lookup — the one-to-many side of a relationship, such as a ticket's child tickets. Its title is the relationship's inverse label. Only children the viewer may read are listed and counted.
usage: Place on record views in a tab or a card for each relationship people navigate ("Child tickets").
Show 3–4 columns: number, title, status, and one owner field.
Enable allowCreate when people create children from the parent.
constraints: relationship must be a spec_object.relationship whose target is the view's entity; columns (1–6) must be fields of the relationship's entity.
Only readable child records are listed and counted; linking a record never grants access to it.
allowCreate shows New only to viewers who may create the child entity; the lookup is prefilled with this record and data rules apply.

binding.description: Queries child records whose lookup references the page's record, permission-filtered.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab enters the list; Up/Down move between rows; Enter opens the record; N opens the create form when allowed.
accessibility.notes: The inverse label and readable count name the list ("Child tickets, 3").

responsive: Below 720px rows show the first column as the title and the rest as a second line.
